title: The women who glowed in the dark ☢️
subject: radium
description:
Did you know their story before today? 👇

The Radium Girls painted glowing watch dials in the 1910s and 1920s and were told the paint was safe. Their fight changed worker safety forever.

Sources: Science Museum Group ("The Radium Girls"), NPR ("Dark Lives Of 'The Radium Girls' Left A Bright Legacy", 2017), Connecticut History
tags: glow in the dark watch dials

scenes.text: These women glowed in the dark. It was killing them.
In the 1910s and 20s, they painted watch dials with radium paint. It got in their hair and on their clothes.
To sharpen each brush, they shaped it with their lips. Lip, dip, paint.
They asked if it was dangerous. Managers said no.
But here's the strange part. Years later, their teeth fell out and bones broke. 5 of them sued.
